# NORTH.md

> A markdown convention that declares a software project's purpose, ambition,
> and precomputed trade-off defaults in a form readable by both humans and AI coding agents.
> It gives agents judgment when the prompt runs out: scaling agency without scaling drift.

## Specification

- [Specification v0.1 (canonical)](https://northfile.dev/spec): the seven canonical sections, with rationale, empirical gates, and examples.
- [Specification raw markdown](https://northfile.dev/spec.md): plain markdown, machine-readable.
- [Spanish Specification](https://northfile.dev/es/spec): versión oficial en español de la especificación canónica.
- [Spanish raw markdown](https://northfile.dev/es/spec.md): especificación en markdown plano en español.
- [Full LLM dump](https://northfile.dev/llms-full.txt): full specification text inlined for LLM consumption.
- [Ecosystem Comparison](https://northfile.dev/compare): comprehensive matrix comparing NORTH.md with AGENTS.md, design.md, SOUL.md, and CONSTITUTION.md.

## Reference

- [README](https://github.com/berthelius/north): repository introduction.
- [Examples](https://northfile.dev/examples): NORTH.md files across multiple project domains (SaaS, OSS, agency, internal platform).
- [Why](https://northfile.dev/why): why projects need an explicit direction and decision arbitration layer.
- [FAQ](https://northfile.dev/faq): common questions.
- [Changelog](https://northfile.dev/changelog): specification version history.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- [Canonical spec v0.1 (JSON)](https://northfile.dev/api/spec/v0.1.json): JSON Schema representation of the v0.1 spec.
- [Canonical spec v0.1 (markdown)](https://northfile.dev/api/spec/v0.1.md): canonical raw markdown specification.
- [LLM index (JSON)](https://northfile.dev/.well-known/llms.json): machine-readable pointer file for LLM agents discovering the spec.

## Agent Context Ecosystem (5-Layer Stack)

- [CONSTITUTION.md](https://agentconstitution.dev): non-negotiable negative safety boundaries (Layer 1).
- [AGENTS.md](https://agents.md): agent operational instructions and execution (Layer 2).
- [design.md](https://northfile.dev/compare): visual design system contracts and UI tokens (Layer 3).
- [SOUL.md](https://soul.md): project identity and voice (Layer 4).
- [NORTH.md](https://northfile.dev): project purpose, ambition, and trade-off defaults (Layer 5).
